snippet.title: Black Tides Draga’s Wake - First Look Gameplay
snippet.description:
"Fight for your survival... or die trying."

Outmatched. Outnumbered. Don't lose yourself. 

Black Tides Draga’s Wake is a visceral third-person action horror-adventure set in an alternate 1900s where ancient Gods and vessels of steam and steel collide.  

Seeking Funding and publishing opportunities.
